description: Human-approved V2 varied charcoal slabs for ordinary dungeon floors, including the shared base under the guiding overlay.
generation: Existing floor stone artwork with PixelLab-derived weathering, prepared into connected D flagstone, mapped to the D5 charcoal palette, then varied locally in slab subdivision, joint position and surface wear.
processing: Approved 512x512 RGBA sprites copied byte for byte into canonical asset slots; no regeneration, color adjustment or resampling during installation.

review.seed_scope: Review tile placement only; all eight approved tile images are shared by the review seeds. This is not a gameplay or texture-generation seed.
review.runtime_source: Canonical PNGs in assets/world; no review staging files are loaded or regenerated at runtime.

source_quality.approval: User approved V2 with the Seed 71 review layout for implementation.
source_quality.continuity: Shared textured 12px source-plane collar and matching mortar profiles allow every directed pair of the eight variants to join along both isometric axes.
source_quality.variation: Interior slab lengths, subdivisions and cross-joint positions vary with stone shading, mottled wear, pits and occasional hairline fractures.
source_quality.geometry: All variants retain the reviewed D5 alpha silhouette and lower masonry lip; the canonical walking plane has a 2:1 diamond footprint.

continuity.policy: Final exported RGBA boundary samples must match for every ordered variant pair; every sampled walking-plane pixel must be opaque.
